name: Sistema-de-Precatorio
description: Precatorio management system: case pipeline, buyer matching and SLA alerts, with a backend-free demo.

paragraphs: A full-stack system to run the buy side of Brazilian precatórios: intake, OCR of court documents, explainable matching with buyers, quotes, negotiation and a stage pipeline with SLA alerts. NestJS + Prisma + PostgreSQL on the back, React on the front, one shared rules package.
